name: UGC 3587 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3587, a low surface brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3587-hubble
story: UGC 3587 is a massive galaxy with an unusually dim, diffuse glow. Hubble searched it for globular clusters, whose presence and makeup hint at how such faint galaxies formed.

claims.text: UGC 03587 is one of six massive low surface brightness galaxies targeted by HST program 10550
The presence or absence of globular clusters constrains how LSB galaxies formed and evolved
An ACS/HST survey searched for globular clusters in massive LSB galaxies
